svg.title: A Mastercard agentic token in an existing checkout form: a signed agent at the edge, a DTVC in card fields, Verifiable Intent L3a and L3b
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: A Mastercard agentic token in an existing checkout form: a signed agent at the edge, a DTVC in card fields, Verifiable Intent L3a and L3b. 8 participants: Consumer, Agent platform (registered agent), CDN or merchant edge, Mastercard key directory (location not public), Merchant checkout, Acquirer or PSP, Mastercard network and token service, and Issuer. 14 steps, 13 crossing a trust boundary, 6 failure branches. Based on several protocols Agent Pay developer guides (unversioned, read 2026-10-11) Verifiable Intent 0.1 (main at 356c296) (2026-04-20). Step 1: Consumer to Agent platform (registered agent): Delegate the purchase: sign Verifiable Intent L2 (specified live use not shown publicly). This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 2: Agent platform (registered agent) to CDN or merchant edge: GET product page, RFC 9421 signature with tag Agent-pay-auth. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 3: CDN or merchant edge to Mastercard key directory (location not public): Fetch the agent key by keyid (directory location unknown). This step crosses a trust boundary. If Key not found in the directory: Mastercard's Level 1 decision table blocks the request. Step 4: CDN or merchant edge to Merchant checkout: Verify window, nonce, tag and signature, then forward. This step crosses a trust boundary. If No Signature-Input or no scheme tag: Sent to the merchant's non-agent bot policy. If A required field is missing: Blocked. Step 5: Merchant checkout to Agent platform (registered agent): Checkout page with standard card fields (and a checkout_jwt, per spec). This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 6: Agent platform (registered agent) to Mastercard network and token service: Request a Virtual Card Token checkout for the merchant domain. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 7: Mastercard network and token service to Agent platform (registered agent): Return the token, its expiry and a one-time DTVC. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 8: Agent platform (registered agent) to Agent platform (registered agent): Sign L3a and L3b linked by checkout_hash (specified live use not shown publicly). Step 9: Agent platform (registered agent) to CDN or merchant edge: POST the card form: token, expiry and DTVC in standard fields. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 10: Agent platform (registered agent) to Merchant checkout: Present L1, L2 and L3b to the merchant (specified transport not defined). This step crosses a trust boundary. If checkout_hash differs from the merchant's own checkout_jwt hash: Checkout-payment mismatch the merchant rejects the order. Step 11: Merchant checkout to Acquirer or PSP: Submit the authorization. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 12: Acquirer or PSP to Mastercard network and token service: Authorization: detokenize, validate the DTVC, check L3a (per spec). This step crosses a trust boundary. If The DTVC fails or was already used: The issuer is told the DTVC result and can decline. If The amount exceeds the L2 amount_range or budget: Per spec the network rejects the chain no published response code. Step 13: Mastercard network and token service to Issuer: Route with the DTVC result and assurance data. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 14: Issuer to Merchant checkout: Approve or decline, then disputes under standard rules. This step crosses a trust boundary.
